mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to wage inflation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1.5 million units signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST > 1.5 million and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a weakening supply chain, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -2% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 0.5% month-over-month signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS MoM > 0.5% and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE < 4% and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals inflationary pressure with easing monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with easing monetary policy
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.
